Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
/*
** retrieve information from the database.
*/

declare
 cursor cur_mastcd (p_code_type varchar2, p_code varchar2) is
 select description
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = p_code_type
 and code = p_code
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1); 
/*
 and eff_date <= to_date(to_char(trunc(sysdate)))
 and (term_date >= to_date(to_char(trunc(sysdate)))
 Or
 term_date is null);
*/

 cursor cur_recrt is 
 select a.recruiter_id, rtrim(b.user_last_name) || ', ' || rtrim(b.user_first_name) name
 from territory_assignments a, system_users b
 where a.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and a.territory_id = :ctrl_block.territory_id
 and b.staff_no = a.recruiter_id
 and sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date, sysdate +1)
 and sysdate between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date, sysdate +1);

begin
 /*
 ** first get description for resource code
 */
 begin
 open cur_mastcd('TRRTY', :valid_territories.territory_type);
 fetch cur_mastcd into :valid_territories.terr_type_desc;

 if cur_mastcd%NOTFOUND then
 show_error('11010');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 close cur_mastcd;

 open cur_mastcd('TRGRP', :valid_territories.territory_group);
 fetch cur_mastcd into :valid_territories.terr_group_desc;

 if cur_mastcd%NOTFOUND then
 show_error('11011');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 close cur_mastcd;
 end;

 begin
 open cur_recrt;
 fetch cur_recrt
 into :ctrl_block.recruiter_id, :ctrl_block.recruiter_name;

 if cur_recrt%NOTFOUND then
 :ctrl_block.recruiter_id := 'NONE';
 :ctrl_block.recruiter_name := 'Not Assigned';
 end if;
 close cur_recrt;
 end;

end;

Trigger.Name: GET_TOTALS1

/* Modified and verified for Y2k...Sobha...06/99 */
/*
** calculate totals
*/
begin
message( ' In Get tot' ); pause;
 select count(ds.sponsor_id), sum(ds.projected_show), sum(ds.projected_draw)
 into :ctrl_spon.total_spon, :ctrl_spon.total_proj_show, :ctrl_spon.total_proj_draw 
 from drive_sponsors ds, drives d
 where exists (select sponsor_id 
 from sponsors
 where sponsor_id = ds.sponsor_id 
 and territory_id = decode( :ctrl_block.territory_id, 'ALL', 
 territory_id, :ctrl_block.territory_id)
 and lob = decode( :ctrl_spon.spon_lob, 'ALL', 
 lob, :ctrl_spon.spon_lob))
 and d.drive_id = ds.drive_id
 and d.drive_date between to_date(:ctrl_spon.disp_from_date, 'MM-DD-RR')
 and to_date(:ctrl_spon.disp_to_date, 'MM-DD-RR')
 and d.status not in ('CANCL', 'HOLD')
 and d.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and ds.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
message( 'Af 1' ); pause;

 select sum( decode( deferral_reason, null, 1, 0)), 
 sum( decode( deferral_reason, null, 0, 1))
 into :ctrl_spon.total_act_draw, :ctrl_spon.total_dfrl 
 from donations a, drive_sponsors b, sponsors c
 where b.sponsor_id in (select sponsor_id 
 from sponsors
 where territory_id = decode( :ctrl_block.territory_id, 'ALL', 
 territory_id, :ctrl_block.territory_id)
 and lob like decode( :ctrl_spon.spon_lob, 'ALL', 
 '%', :ctrl_spon.spon_lob))
 and a.drive_id = b.drive_id
 and b.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and a.chapter_id = b.chapter_id
 and b.sponsor_id = c.sponsor_id
 and a.chapter_id = c.chapter_id;


 :ctrl_spon.total_act_show := nvl( :ctrl_spon.total_act_draw, 0 ) 
 + nvl( :ctrl_spon.total_dfrl, 0 );

end;

PROCEDURE populate_drive_stats (status varchar2,
 from_date date,
 end_date date)
IS
 h_category varchar2(10);
 h_count number;
 h_territory_count number;
 h_other_count number;

 cursor cur_drive is
 select decode(open_drive_ind, 'Y', 'Open', 'N', 'Contained', 'Unknown'), 
 count(drive_id)
 from drives
 where drive_date between from_date and end_date
 and territory_id = :ctrl_block.territory_id
 and drive_type != 'F'
 group by open_drive_ind;

 cursor cur_drvtype is
 select a.description, count(b.drive_id)
 from valid_master_codes a, drives b
 where b.drive_date between from_date and end_date
 and b.territory_id = :ctrl_block.territory_id
 and a.code = b.drive_type
 and a.code_type = 'DRVTY'
 group by a.description;

BEGIN

 open cur_drive;
 loop
 fetch cur_drive into h_category, h_count;
 exit when cur_drive%NOTFOUND;
 if h_category = 'Open' then
 if status = 'CURR' then
 :ctrl_drives.curr_open_drives := h_count;
 else
 :ctrl_drives.last_open_drives := h_count;
 end if;
 else
 if status = 'CURR' then
 :ctrl_drives.curr_cont_drives := h_count;
 else
 :ctrl_drives.last_cont_drives := h_count;
 end if;
 end if;
 end loop;
 close cur_drive;

 if status = 'CURR' then
 :ctrl_drives.curr_open_drives := nvl( :ctrl_drives.curr_open_drives, 0);
 :ctrl_drives.curr_cont_drives := nvl( :ctrl_drives.curr_cont_drives, 0);
 :ctrl_drives.curr_total_drives := :ctrl_drives.curr_open_drives + :ctrl_drives.curr_cont_drives;
 elsif status = 'LAST' then
 :ctrl_drives.last_open_drives := nvl( :ctrl_drives.last_open_drives, 0);
 :ctrl_drives.last_cont_drives := nvl( :ctrl_drives.last_cont_drives, 0);
 :ctrl_drives.last_total_drives := :ctrl_drives.last_open_drives + :ctrl_drives.last_cont_drives;
 end if;

 /*
 ** we must retrieve details about *type* of the drive
 */
 open cur_drvtype;
 loop
 fetch cur_drvtype into h_category, h_count;
 exit when cur_drvtype%NOTFOUND;

 if h_category = 'Inside' then
 if status = 'CURR' then
 :ctrl_drives.curr_inside_drives := h_count;
 else
 :ctrl_drives.last_inside_drives := h_count;
 end if;
 elsif h_category = 'Coach' then
 if status = 'CURR' then
 :ctrl_drives.curr_coach_drives := h_count;
 else
 :ctrl_drives.last_coach_drives := h_count;
 end if;
 elsif h_category = 'Fixed' then
 if status = 'CURR' then
 :ctrl_drives.curr_fixed_drives := h_count;
 else
 :ctrl_drives.last_fixed_drives := h_count;
 end if;
 end if;
 end loop;
 close cur_drvtype;

 if status = 'CURR' then
 :ctrl_drives.curr_inside_drives := nvl( :ctrl_drives.curr_inside_drives, 0);
 :ctrl_drives.curr_coach_drives := nvl( :ctrl_drives.curr_coach_drives, 0);
 :ctrl_drives.curr_fixed_drives := nvl( :ctrl_drives.curr_fixed_drives, 0);
 elsif status = 'LAST' then
 :ctrl_drives.last_inside_drives := nvl( :ctrl_drives.last_inside_drives, 0);
 :ctrl_drives.last_coach_drives := nvl( :ctrl_drives.last_coach_drives, 0);
 :ctrl_drives.last_fixed_drives := nvl( :ctrl_drives.last_fixed_drives, 0);
 end if;

-- synchronize;
-- redisplay;
END;

FUNCTION calculate_cost (start_date date, end_date date) RETURN number IS

 h_setup_time number;
 h_err_flag VARCHAR2(1);
 h_cost number;
 h_total_cost number;
 h_total_drives number;
 h_status varchar2(5);

 cursor cur_drive is
 select drive_id, location_id, SCHEDULE_STUP_BKDOWN_TIME
 from drives
 where drive_date between start_date and end_date
 and territory_id = :ctrl_block.territory_id;

 h_total_drives := 0;

 open cur_drive;
 loop

 exit when cur_drive%NOTFOUND;

 don_cost_analysis.calc_proj_cost(h_drive_id, h_location, h_setup_time, h_cost, h_err_flag);
-- message (h_drive_id || ', ' || h_location || ', ' || to_char(h_setup_time) || '<' || to_char(h_cost, '99.00PR') || '>'); pause;
 if h_err_flag = 'N' then
 h_total_cost := h_total_cost + h_cost;
 h_total_drives := h_total_drives + 1;
 h_status := 'OKAY';
/*
 else

 h_total_cost := 0;
 h_status := 'ERROR';
 exit;
*/

-- message (h_status || '- ' || to_char(h_total_cost) || ', ' || to_char(h_total_drives)); pause;

 else

 end if;
END;

 h_upper := max_units;
 end if;

 for i in min_units..max_units
 loop
 if h_lower > max_units then
 exit;
 end if;
 create_record;

 :unit_range.unit_range := to_char(h_lower) || ' - ' || to_char(h_upper);
-- message('Working....' || to_char(h_lower) || ', ' || to_char(h_upper) || ' projected.', no_acknowledge);
-- synchronize;
-- redisplay;
 h_count := 0;
 open cur_drive(h_lower, h_upper);
 loop
 fetch cur_drive into h_count;
 exit when cur_drive%NOTFOUND;
 end loop;
 close cur_drive;
 :unit_range.projected := h_count;

-- message('Working....' || to_char(h_lower) || ', ' || to_char(h_upper) || ' Actual.', no_acknowledge);
 h_count := 0;
 open cur_actualm(h_lower, h_upper);
 loop
 fetch cur_actualm into h_drive_id;
 exit when cur_actualm%NOTFOUND;
 end loop;
 h_count := cur_actualm%rowcount;
 close cur_actualm;
 :unit_range.actuals := h_count;


 if :unit_range.projected is null
 or :unit_range.projected = 0 then
 :unit_range.percent := 'N/A';
 else
 :unit_range.percent := round( (:unit_range.actuals / :unit_range.projected ) * 100, 2 );
 end if;

 h_lower := h_upper + 1;
 if h_lower + lot_size < max_units then
 h_upper := h_lower + lot_size -1;
 else
 h_upper := max_units;
 end if;
-- synchronize;
-- redisplay;
 end loop; -- for loop

 set_block_property('unit_range', insert_allowed, property_false);
 set_block_property('unit_range', update_allowed, property_false);
 set_block_property('unit_range', delete_allowed, property_false);
 set_application_property(cursor_style, 'DEFAULT');
 clear_message;
 go_record(1);

exception
 when others then
 set_application_property(cursor_style, 'BUSY');
END;
